canonicalRoute: authenticated connected Remote seat on the canonical server projection
the last authenticated socket for one Remote player closes and records disconnected presence at the unchanged Core revision
recovery hello authenticates the server-issued roomId, participantId, and seatCapability tuple without changing presence
the first authorized variable-v2 projection request atomically records connected presence and returns online-projected-snapshot-v1 with reason rejoined
a same-revision server notice forces every connected peer to request a fresh authoritative projection
both seats converge on the same canonical revision and shared public projection subset before controls reopen

eligibility.authority: Core state, server room presence, and the server capability grant are authoritative; localStorage only carries the server-issued recovery tuple
eligibility.advisoryBoundary: browser phase, connection epoch, cached projection, and UI state cannot authorize recovery, infer success, or advance priority

supported: ordinary disconnect and reconnect change room presence only and do not add a Core command, accepted receipt, checkpoint, or revision
one of multiple authenticated sockets closing does not disconnect the identity; only the last authenticated socket closing changes presence
the recovery identity is the exact server-issued roomId, participantId, and seatCapability tuple for the same pending player seat
ordinary transport loss retains the recovery tuple while explicit leave, terminal invalidation, expiry, revocation, or a missing seat clears or rejects it

production variable-v2 hello authenticates without changing presence; its first authorized projection request performs the disconnected-to-connected same-revision compare-and-set and that accepted snapshot alone carries reason rejoined
successful recovery exposes a visible 再接続しました status only from the accepted server snapshot reason rejoined; connection epoch, hello acceptance, or phase alone is not success evidence
a same-revision server notice is an authoritative presence-refresh trigger; clients disable gameplay while fetching it and reopen controls only after the fresh projection is accepted

a disconnected participant cannot submit an online command, tabletop intent, visibility intent, shared undo, manual combat damage, or priority action; the server rejects it as PARTICIPANT_NOT_CONNECTED with revision, Core state, receipts, and checkpoint unchanged
connected seats retain only normal server and Core eligibility; they cannot proxy, auto-pass, auto-skip, or force an action for a disconnected seat
when priority belongs to a disconnected seat the game waits for authenticated recovery or an explicit server-authorized player exit
deferred: automatic disconnect timers, bot substitution, forced pass, and forced concession remain prohibited outside an explicit later product decision
replacement of the established lobby recovery storage schema is outside this game-session slice

outcomes.unavailable: a disconnected seat remains visibly unavailable and cannot mutate the game until authenticated recovery completes
outcomes.accepted: the authorized seat receives explicit server-originated rejoined status at the unchanged presence revision and both seats converge on the same revision and shared public projection subset; audience-private fields remain seat-specific
outcomes.rejected: a disconnected command or superseded-generation, revoked, expired, missing-seat, room-mismatched, participant-mismatched, or capability-mismatched recovery credential leaves revision and Core state unchanged; a lower known Core revision remains eligible for an authoritative snapshot; bounded rate, audit, and lease security records may change
outcomes.failed: silent command acceptance, a revision change caused only by presence, inferred reconnect success, missing rejoined status, proxy priority progression, or divergent projections fails the journey

sameSlice: Remote reconnect success inferred from connectionEpoch, browser phase, or cached projection
variable-v2 command paths that accept game-changing input from a disconnected participant
variable-v2 hello or projection paths that synthesize reconnect success without the same-revision presence compare-and-set
the variable-v2 disconnect early-return that skips last-socket presence persistence
PersonalWorkbench, guided-action, or local GameApplication adapters used as Remote reconnect authority
retained: the versioned public lobby recovery record and server validation that carry the recovery tuple
bounded browser transport retry and pending-command replay after authoritative resynchronization
manual gameplay primitives for unsupported card semantics after the seat is connected

positive: the peer observes disconnected then connected presence without a Core revision change
the recovered seat displays 再接続しました only from an accepted server reason rejoined
both seats recover the same revision and equal shared public projection subset before gameplay resumes while their private audience fields remain isolated
normal priority ownership and HOLD state survive the presence-only recovery
negative: a disconnected participant command is rejected before application with revision, Core state, receipts, and checkpoint unchanged
closing one of multiple authenticated sockets leaves the identity connected and does not block its remaining socket

superseded-generation, revoked, expired, missing-seat, room-mismatched, participant-mismatched, and capability-mismatched recovery credentials return a generic non-oracle failure without credential echo or canonical-game mutation; a stale known Core revision alone is not an identity failure
missing rejoined reason, presence-only revision drift, one-seat recovery, projection divergence, silent no-op, proxy action, auto-pass, and auto-skip fail evidence
